entities.summary: Jordan Hunter Gross is an American professional ice hockey defenseman who is currently playing for Traktor Chelyabinsk in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He has formerly played with the Arizona Coyotes, Colorado Avalanche and the Nashville Predators in the National Hockey League (NHL).
